sections.title: Over 100 patterns, *mixed and matched*
body: Anyone can add a touch of timeless elegance to an event with our vintage china rental service. We have over 100 vintage china designs to choose from, and we will mix and match your rental into a thoughtfully curated table to impress your guests.
Our vintage china and new china options are available free of charge to those who use our event services.
list: Free of charge with our event planning

sections.title: Born from a passion for *celebrating*
body: With over 30 years of experience in marketing and event planning, Simply Social Events and More was born out of a passion for helping people celebrate life's milestones. From weddings to retirement parties, we take pride in creating memorable experiences for our clients.
We work closely with you to understand your vision. Our services are designed for adult clients, ensuring a sophisticated and distinctive event.
